name: Consecrated Rune
summary: In Coldridge Valley, the Consecrated Rune calls fledgling dwarven paladins to Anvilmar. Bromos Grummner sends them to begin their formal duties as Knights of the Silver Hand.

sections.title: A Calling to the Silver Hand
sections.body: A Consecrated Rune marks a novice dwarf’s place among the Knights of the Silver Hand. Dwarven paladins receive one in Coldridge Valley after proving basic skill in arms. Sacred words are inscribed on the rune, and the Holy Light blesses it. Bromos Grummner, the paladin trainer inside Anvilmar, sends the rune as an official summons. Dwarves hold great respect for the Holy Light traditions their human allies introduced to them. Reading the rune confirms the novice’s place in the order and marks a passage into its service.

faq.q: What is the Consecrated Rune used for?
faq.answer: The Consecrated Rune summons novice dwarven paladins to seek Bromos Grummner inside Anvilmar and continue their paladin training.
Bromos Grummner sends the Consecrated Rune from Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, where he trains dwarven paladins.

faq.q: Why do dwarven paladins follow the traditions of the Silver Hand?
faq.answer: Dwarves learned much of the Holy Light and the Silver Hand’s ways from human mentors. They revere the order’s history, traditions, and belief that a single sacrifice can alter Azeroth’s fate.

angles.text: As a dwarven paladin, receiving the rune marks your formal step into the Knights of the Silver Hand under Bromos Grummner’s guidance.
As a dwarf, the rune reflects how human holy traditions have joined dwarven martial culture through the shared alliance and mutual respect between Ironforge and humanity.
